blocks.text: A cold store keeps goods at a set temperature. The building must stop heat from entering. Gaps, thin walls or leaks make the cooling system work harder and cost more to run.

Steel Mind supplies the steel frame, the roof and wall structure, and the supports for insulated panels. The refrigeration plant is installed by the cooling specialist you choose, and Steel Mind coordinates the loads and openings with that specialist.

Thick insulated panels with sealed joints reduce heat gain. Frame connections are detailed to avoid heat paths where possible. The roof and frames carry condensers, ducts and hanging evaporators. The floor needs insulation, and the doors must seal tightly. Vapor barriers and good detailing prevent water inside the walls.
Fruit and vegetable traders, dairy and meat processors, pharmaceutical distributors and food exporters use cold stores.
